body:
Closes a gap named twice and left open: king_reward_wave spawns 3 bonus lane creeps for the killer's team at the contested center waypoint (not the spawn line) with +50% HP, a real tempo swing beyond the existing buff/econ reward. 1 new test, 1191 PASS, zero regressions. commit a19a81a.

⚓ ☃
title: King kills now spawn a reward wave of lane creeps (boss-death-as-match-event)
